extends.title: Inheritance Specification
extends.description: Specifies parent configurations to inherit from. Can be a single configuration name (string) for single inheritance, or an array of names for multiple inheritance. Parent configurations are merged in order, with later ones taking precedence.

name.description: Unique identifier for the configuration object. Must contain only alphanumeric characters, hyphens, and underscores.

template.title: Template Flag
